invariant: FallbackPreservesLocalityAndPrivacy: If a task requires local-only execution or has sensitive/restricted data classification, all primary, fallback, and delegated placements must remain strictly on healthy local endpoints
preconditions: Task marked requirements.localOnly: true or dataClassification in ('sensitive', 'restricted'); primary local model/runtime becomes unavailable; hosted providers (OpenAI/Anthropic) or remote server workers registered and online
sequence: 1. Local endpoint fails health or availability check; 2. Scheduler resolveRoutingConstraint was AUTO because it only checked cfg.mode and execution.routingMode; 3. Scheduler fell back to registered hosted models or external delegated agents; 4. Sensitive code/data sent to third-party hosted API without authorization
expected: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
patch: planAvailableRoute and scheduler.plan fail closed with SchedulingError; hosted provider is never invoked
post_fix_evidence: Scheduled on hosted provider gpt-4o/anthropic; planAvailableRoute fell back across boundary
status: resolveRoutingConstraint returns LOCAL_ONLY if task.policy.localOnly, requirements.localOnly, or dataClassification in ('sensitive', 'restricted'); resolveForTask rejects external delegated agents; effectivePolicyForHosted enforces allowHostedProviders: false; routeAvailability duck-types ModelLifecycleError
limitations: Vitest providerFallbackBoundaries.test.ts tests 1 & 2 pass; apps/cli/tests/hostedProviderFailure.test.ts (2/2) and apps/cli/tests/modelLifecycle.test.ts (22/22) pass
column20: Requires callers to properly designate localOnly or sensitive dataClassification on tasks

invariant: FallbackPreservesLocalityAndPrivacy: Local-only or sensitive execution requests must never fall back to external CLI or ACP remote harnesses
preconditions: Task has policyContext.localOnly: true or dataClassification in ('sensitive', 'restricted'); primary native runner fails with infrastructure error; external-cli or remote ACP runner registered
sequence: 1. Native harness encounters spawn/infrastructure error; 2. HarnessDispatchService evaluates eligible fallback candidates; 3. evaluateCandidateEligibility only checked provider_only constraint and ignored localOnly/dataClassification; 4. Fallback silently dispatched sensitive task to external-cli/ACP harness
expected: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
patch: Dispatch terminates with status failed; external harness execute is never called
post_fix_evidence: Dispatched to external-cli runner, transmitting task input and workspace context externally
status: Added check in evaluateCandidateEligibility blocking external-cli, ACP, and non-local harnesses when policyContext.localOnly is true or dataClassification is sensitive/restricted
limitations: Vitest providerFallbackBoundaries.test.ts test 3 passes; packages/core/tests/harnessDispatch.test.ts (13/13) pass with 0 regressions
column20: Relies on accurate runner descriptor.kind ('native' vs 'external-cli'/'acp')

invariant: FallbackWithinBudgetLimit: Harness fallback execution must fail closed when cumulative spend or wall-clock usage exhausts the declared task budget
preconditions: Primary harness attempt fails with infrastructure error but incurs usage exceeding maxCostUSD, maxTokens, maxToolCalls, or maxDurationMs; allowFallback is true
sequence: 1. Primary harness fails after spending $3.00 on a $2.00 maxCostUSD budget; 2. HarnessDispatchService loops to candidate 2; 3. dispatch recalculated remainingCostUSD with Math.max(0, ...), passing 0 but not checking budget exhaustion before re-dispatch; 4. Fallback runner ran and consumed further unbudgeted spend
expected: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
patch: Dispatch aborts fallback immediately; returns status failed with failureClassification BUDGET_EXHAUSTED or MAX_COST_EXCEEDED
post_fix_evidence: Fallback harness invoked and executed despite exhausted cost budget
status: Added pre-fallback guard in dispatch checking maxCostUSD, maxTokens, maxToolCalls, and maxDurationMs exhaustion before invoking subsequent candidates, failing closed immediately
limitations: Vitest providerFallbackBoundaries.test.ts test 4 passes; all 13/13 harnessDispatch tests pass
column20: Actual spend reporting depends on harness runner returning accurate usage.costUSD and usage.durationMs

invariant: ShadowRespectsPolicyFilters: Shadow policy evaluation, exploration, and live execution must adhere to task allowedModels, allowedRuntimes, allowedComputers, and cost delta constraints
preconditions: Task sets task.policy.allowedModels, allowedRuntimes, or allowedComputers; or requests live shadow execution exceeding perTaskMaxCostDeltaUSD
sequence: 1. Task pins specific model in policy.allowedModels; 2. ShadowRouterService scored all candidates disregarding allowedModels/allowedRuntimes; 3. Custom policy evaluate() returned unapproved candidate; 4. Candidate selected for exploration or duplicate live execution; 5. Unapproved model executed
expected: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
patch: Unapproved models/runtimes excluded from candidate scoring and exploration; live shadow duplicate respects perTaskMaxCostDeltaUSD
post_fix_evidence: Unapproved models scored, ranked, and selected; live shadow execution permitted cost exceeding perTaskMaxCostDeltaUSD
status: Filtered candidates in scoreCandidatesForPolicy by allowedModels/allowedRuntimes/allowedComputers; validated custom evaluate returns; blocked exploration when single model pinned; added perTaskMaxCostDeltaUSD check to liveShadowExecutionAuthorized
limitations: Vitest providerFallbackBoundaries.test.ts tests 5 & 6 pass; packages/core/tests/shadowRouter.test.ts (16/16) pass with 0 regressions
column20: Custom router policies must not override core safety filters

invariant: PlacementEnforcesComputerLocality: Stale instances on offline computers must not be scheduled or boosted; sensitive tasks must not be placed on remote server computers
preconditions: Stale instance exists on offline/crashed computer; only remote server computer online; task has dataClassification: 'sensitive'
sequence: 1. Model instance registered on remote server computer; 2. Scheduler residency scored offline computer instances +30 and marked READY; 3. scheduleComputer allowed placement on remote server because model record was marked local: true; 4. Sensitive code placed on remote server computer
expected: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
patch: Scheduler throws SchedulingError rejecting placement on remote computer for sensitive task
post_fix_evidence: Scheduled on remote computer remote-worker-1 despite sensitive data classification
status: Filtered dead runtimes and offline computers in residency/preferredWorker; passed runtimeAvailable and workerAvailable to router assess; rejected non-local computers (!computer.local) in scheduleComputer when localOnly or sensitive/restricted
column20: Requires accurate computer.local flag in ComputerRegistry
